claim_boundary: The primary literature supports realized bipower variation as comparatively robust to rare jumps and the realized-versus-bipower decomposition as a way to expose discontinuous price variation. Bitcoin research finds that jumps occur and cluster, but also warns that low-frequency sampling can spuriously label volatility bursts as jumps. The H1 ratio below is therefore only a decision-time jumpiness proxy. Exactly one separately frozen equal-capital historical screen may test whether excluding unusually jumpy days improves DRA economics; failure closes the family without tuning.

feature_contract.formula: sum(hourly close-to-close simple returns squared) / ((pi/2) * sum(adjacent absolute hourly return products)), divided by the median of the prior 20 complete UTC-day ratios

prior_matrix.finding: Realized bipower variation is comparatively robust to rare jumps and can estimate integrated variance, while realized variance minus bipower variation estimates the quadratic variation of the jump component under the paper's asymptotic setting.
prior_matrix.identity: Barndorff-Nielsen and Shephard, Power and bipower variation with stochastic volatility and jumps (2004)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The asymptotic estimator does not prescribe a 24-observation H1 ratio, BTC strategy, rolling normalization or admission threshold.

prior_matrix.finding: Tick-level Bitcoin evidence found frequent, clustered jumps associated with order-flow imbalance, aggressive traders and wider spreads; jumps had short-term activity and illiquidity effects and persistent price impact.
prior_matrix.identity: Scaillet, Treccani and Trevisan, High-Frequency Jump Analysis of the Bitcoin Market (2020)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Mt. Gox tick data from 2011-2013 cannot establish modern OKX H1 timing or DRA entry alpha.

prior_matrix.finding: The Bitcoin jump study explicitly notes that low-frequency jump measures can spuriously assign volatility bursts to jumps, so H1 evidence must not be presented as a formal jump classification.
prior_matrix.identity: Scaillet, Treccani and Trevisan, High-Frequency Jump Analysis of the Bitcoin Market (2020)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The screen may test only a relative price-path jumpiness proxy and must close without tuning if economic breadth is absent.

prior_matrix.finding: Bitcoin realized-volatility research reported that explicitly modelling jumps and signed estimators helped longer-horizon variance forecasts but was unnecessary for short-horizon forecasts.
prior_matrix.identity: Hu, Härdle and Kuo, Risk of Bitcoin Market: Volatility, Jumps, and Forecasts (2021 draft)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Volatility-forecast utility does not imply one-day DRA return improvement, and the mixed horizon result prevents an assumed positive strategy transfer.

real_time_design_requirements: Use only hourly closes contained in the latest complete UTC day plus the immediately preceding close needed for its first return, and the prior 20 complete-day feature values.
Use simple close-to-close returns, realized variance and pi-over-two-scaled adjacent absolute-return products exactly as frozen; call the result a jumpiness proxy rather than a jump detector.
Fail closed on non-positive realized or bipower variation and do not add an epsilon, truncate a return, remove a day or change sampling.
Keep the DRA parent, side, lot cost, capacity, exits, fee, adverse slippage, cooldown, and fill clock unchanged.
Freeze primary 1.0 and neighbors 0.8 and 1.2 before outcome access; do not search another lookback, threshold, jump statistic, log-return variant or relation.
Require Design and Validation PnL improvement, annual breadth, path-risk non-inferiority, holding support, and neighbor stability; otherwise close the family.
Do not open post-2024 OOS or create a candidate from this prior audit.
uncertainty: Twenty-four hourly returns are much coarser than the high-frequency asymptotic setting of bipower-variation jump tests.
Simple returns are a deterministic approximation to the log-return formulation common in realized-variation research.
The relative RV-to-BV ratio can respond to volatility clustering and sampling noise as well as genuine discontinuities.
No post-2024 evidence, OOS, candidate, runtime filter, or Trading path was accessed or authorized.
